Acting as a subject-matter expert, they will ensure submitted models are accurate, consistent, technically robust, and suitable for load-flow, short-circuit, dynamic, stability, and electromagnetic transient studies.

This position also plays an important leadership role within the engineering team by mentoring other engineers, delivering internal training, developing technical guidelines and checklists, and improving model-validation processes.

Location: Calgary, AB

Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Schedule: Hybrid

Lead independent technical reviews and validation of project models used in power-system studies. Review Project Data Update Packages to ensure model accuracy, consistency, completeness, and compliance with applicable requirements. Validate model logic, assumptions, data sources, methodologies, parameterization, and study results. Review generator, plant, transmission network, and static and dynamic models.
